summary: Specifies conventions for how S/MIME version 4.0 agents use X.509 certificates. Certificates are central to S/MIME processing, and agents validate them as described in RFC 5280. It is a standards-track document that goes with the S/MIME 4.0 message specification.

eli5.summary: Secure email needs a kind of digital ID card to prove who you are. This document sets the rules for how email programs check and use those ID cards.
